name: Death
title: The Last Enemy
description: The personified adversary of the three Peverell brothers in the wizarding fable "The Tale of the Three Brothers", who gifted them the Elder Wand, the Resurrection Stone, and the Invisibility Cloak, together known as the Deathly Hallows.

name: Godric Gryffindor
title: Founder of Gryffindor House
description: One of the four founders of Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, who valued bravery and daring above all and left behind his sword and the Sorting Hat to guide future generations.

name: Salazar Slytherin
title: Founder of Slytherin House
description: A founder of Hogwarts who believed only pure-blood witches and wizards should be taught there, and who, before departing after a rift with his fellow founders, built a hidden Chamber of Secrets beneath the school to one day be opened by his heir.

name: Rowena Ravenclaw
title: Founder of Ravenclaw House
description: A founder of Hogwarts renowned for her intelligence, whose lost diadem, said to grant wisdom to its wearer, was later corrupted into one of Voldemort's Horcruxes.

name: Helga Hufflepuff
title: Founder of Hufflepuff House
description: A founder of Hogwarts who prized hard work, patience, and fair treatment of all students, and whose golden cup was later stolen and turned into one of Voldemort's Horcruxes.

name: Albus Dumbledore
title: Headmaster of Hogwarts
description: Widely regarded as the greatest wizard of his age, the Headmaster of Hogwarts and founder of the Order of the Phoenix, who defeated the dark wizard Grindelwald and was the only person Voldemort ever feared.

name: Lord Voldemort
title: The Dark Lord
description: Born Tom Marvolo Riddle, the most powerful and feared dark wizard of the age, who split his soul into seven Horcruxes in his quest for immortality and terrorized the wizarding world for decades before his final defeat.
aliases: He Who Must Not Be Named

name: Harry Potter
title: The Boy Who Lived
description: An orphaned boy who survived Lord Voldemort's killing curse as an infant, discovered at age eleven that he was a wizard, and spent his years at Hogwarts unraveling the mystery of his parents' deaths before finally defeating Voldemort.

name: Hermione Granger
title: The Brightest Witch of Her Age
description: A brilliant Muggle-born witch and one of Harry Potter's closest friends, whose quick thinking, vast knowledge, and moral conviction repeatedly proved essential to defeating Voldemort.

name: Ron Weasley
title: Harry's Best Friend
description: The youngest Weasley son and Harry Potter's loyal best friend, who overcame his family's poverty and his own insecurities to become a skilled chess strategist and steadfast ally in the fight against Voldemort.

name: Ginny Weasley
title: Chaser of Gryffindor
description: The youngest Weasley child, possessed by Tom Riddle's diary in her first year at Hogwarts, who grew into a formidable witch and Quidditch player, and eventually married Harry Potter.

name: Fred Weasley
title: Co-founder of Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes
description: One of the mischievous Weasley twins, who left Hogwarts early with his brother George to found a joke shop and died fighting for the Order of the Phoenix at the Battle of Hogwarts.

name: George Weasley
title: Co-founder of Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes
description: The surviving half of the Weasley twins, co-founder of the joke shop Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes, who lost an ear in a Death Eater attack and his twin brother at the Battle of Hogwarts.

name: Arthur Weasley
title: Head of the Weasley Family
description: A kindly Ministry of Magic employee fascinated by Muggle artifacts, patriarch of the Weasley family and a trusted member of the Order of the Phoenix.

name: Molly Weasley
title: Matriarch of the Weasley Family
description: The fiercely protective matriarch of the Weasley family, who treated Harry as her own son and struck down Bellatrix Lestrange in a duel defending her children at the Battle of Hogwarts.

name: Neville Longbottom
title: Leader of Dumbledore's Army
description: A seemingly timid Gryffindor whose parents were tortured into insanity by Bellatrix Lestrange, and who grew into one of the war's great heroes, leading resistance at Hogwarts and beheading the snake Nagini.

name: Luna Lovegood
title: Member of Dumbledore's Army
description: An eccentric and unfailingly loyal Ravenclaw who saw the world differently from her peers, joined Dumbledore's Army, and remained one of Harry's most steadfast friends.

name: Cedric Diggory
title: Hogwarts Triwizard Champion
description: The popular and fair-minded Hufflepuff Triwizard Champion who shared the tournament's victory with Harry, only to be murdered by Peter Pettigrew on Voldemort's order moments after they touched the enchanted Triwizard Cup together.

name: Draco Malfoy
title: Harry's Slytherin Rival
description: Harry Potter's arrogant Slytherin rival at Hogwarts and son of Death Eater Lucius Malfoy, reluctantly tasked by Voldemort with murdering Dumbledore, a task he ultimately could not complete.

name: Lucius Malfoy
title: Death Eater
description: A wealthy, influential Death Eater and father of Draco, who secretly planted Tom Riddle's diary on Ginny Weasley and fell from Voldemort's favor after his failure at the Ministry of Magic.

name: Narcissa Malfoy
title: Lady of the Malfoy Family
description: Draco's mother and Bellatrix Lestrange's sister, whose love for her son led her to falsely tell Voldemort that Harry Potter was dead in the Forbidden Forest, a lie that let Harry live to fight on.

name: Severus Snape
title: Potions Master of Hogwarts
description: A cold, exacting Potions Master who outwardly tormented Harry Potter while secretly serving as a spy for Dumbledore and the Order of the Phoenix out of enduring love for Harry's mother, Lily.

name: Minerva McGonagall
title: Deputy Headmistress of Hogwarts
description: The stern but fair Transfiguration professor and Head of Gryffindor House, who led the defense of Hogwarts in the Battle of Hogwarts and later became Headmistress.

name: Rubeus Hagrid
title: Keeper of Keys and Grounds
description: A gentle half-giant and Keeper of Keys and Grounds at Hogwarts, later Care of Magical Creatures professor, who first told Harry he was a wizard and remained one of his most loyal friends.

name: Sirius Black
title: Harry's Godfather
description: James Potter's closest friend and Harry's godfather, wrongly imprisoned in Azkaban for twelve years for a betrayal actually committed by Peter Pettigrew, who escaped to protect Harry before being killed by Bellatrix Lestrange.

name: Remus Lupin
title: Defense Against the Dark Arts Professor
description: A werewolf and one of James Potter's closest school friends, who taught Defense Against the Dark Arts at Hogwarts and fought and died for the Order of the Phoenix at the Battle of Hogwarts.

name: James Potter
title: Harry's Father
description: Harry Potter's father, a talented wizard and leader among the Marauders at Hogwarts, killed alongside his wife Lily by Voldemort at Godric's Hollow while trying to protect their infant son.

name: Lily Potter
title: Harry's Mother
description: Harry Potter's mother, a gifted Muggle-born witch and childhood friend of Severus Snape, whose self-sacrificing death protecting her infant son at Godric's Hollow left him with a protective magic that saved his life for years.

name: Peter Pettigrew
title: The Traitorous Marauder
description: A former Marauder and friend of James Potter who secretly betrayed the Potters' hiding place to Voldemort, framed Sirius Black for the crime, and lived in hiding as an Animagus rat for twelve years before rejoining Voldemort's service.

name: Bellatrix Lestrange
title: Voldemort's Most Loyal Servant
description: Voldemort's most fanatically devoted Death Eater, who tortured Neville Longbottom's parents into insanity and killed her cousin Sirius Black, before being struck down by Molly Weasley at the Battle of Hogwarts.

name: Dolores Umbridge
title: High Inquisitor of Hogwarts
description: A sadistic Ministry of Magic bureaucrat who seized control of Hogwarts as High Inquisitor and Headmistress, persecuting students and staff, and later led the Ministry's Muggle-born persecution under Voldemort's puppet regime.

name: Fawkes
title: Dumbledore's Phoenix
description: Albus Dumbledore's loyal phoenix, whose healing tears saved Harry Potter from Basilisk venom in the Chamber of Secrets and who delivered the Sorting Hat and the Sword of Gryffindor when Harry needed them most.

name: Nagini
title: Voldemort's Serpent
description: Lord Voldemort's giant snake and constant companion, secretly transformed into his final Horcrux, who killed Severus Snape on Voldemort's order and was ultimately beheaded by Neville Longbottom.

name: Buckbeak
title: Hagrid's Hippogriff
description: A proud hippogriff kept by Hagrid, sentenced to execution after injuring the arrogant Draco Malfoy, and saved from death by Harry and Hermione using a Time-Turner.

name: Dobby
title: The Free Elf
description: A house-elf formerly enslaved by the Malfoy family, freed by Harry Potter through a trick with a sock, who died protecting Harry and his friends from Bellatrix Lestrange during their escape from Malfoy Manor.

name: Aragog
title: Patriarch of the Acromantulas
description: A monstrous Acromantula raised in secret by Hagrid during his Hogwarts years, who lived deep in the Forbidden Forest and fathered a vast colony of giant spiders.

name: Basilisk
title: The Serpent of Slytherin
description: A gigantic, deadly serpent hidden within the Chamber of Secrets by Salazar Slytherin, whose gaze could kill and whose venom nearly claimed Harry Potter's life before he slew it with the Sword of Gryffindor.

name: Hedwig
title: Harry's Snowy Owl
description: Harry Potter's loyal snowy owl, a gift from Hagrid on his eleventh birthday, who carried his letters for years before being killed shielding him during the escape from Privet Drive.

name: Hogwarts
title: School of Witchcraft and Wizardry
description: An ancient castle and school hidden from Muggles in the Scottish Highlands, founded by Godric Gryffindor, Salazar Slytherin, Rowena Ravenclaw, and Helga Hufflepuff, where generations of witches and wizards, including Harry Potter, have learned magic.

name: Diagon Alley
title: London's Hidden Wizarding Street
description: A cobbled wizarding shopping street hidden behind the Leaky Cauldron in London, home to Gringotts Bank, Ollivanders wand shop, and countless other magical businesses.

name: Gringotts
title: The Wizarding Bank
description: A vast goblin-run bank in Diagon Alley with vaults burrowed deep underground, from which Harry, Ron, and Hermione stole a Horcrux by riding a dragon to escape.

name: Ministry of Magic
title: The Wizarding Government
description: The governing body of the British wizarding world, headquartered underground in London, which fell under Voldemort's secret control through the Imperiused Minister Pius Thicknesse during the final wizarding war.

name: Azkaban
title: The Wizarding Prison
description: A grim island fortress in the North Sea, once guarded by soul-devouring Dementors, where Sirius Black was wrongly imprisoned for twelve years and from which he became the first person ever to escape.

name: The Burrow
title: The Weasley Family Home
description: The ramshackle, magically expanded home of the Weasley family in the English countryside, a warm refuge where Harry Potter often spent his summers away from the Dursleys.

name: Godric's Hollow
title: The Potters' Village
description: A small West Country village where Harry Potter was born and where his parents, James and Lily, were murdered by Voldemort, leaving the infant Harry the only known survivor of the Killing Curse.

name: Forbidden Forest
title: The Dark Woods of Hogwarts
description: A dense, dangerous forest bordering the Hogwarts grounds, home to centaurs, giant spiders, and other perilous creatures, where Harry Potter ultimately walked to what he believed would be his death.

name: Privet Drive
title: The Dursleys' House
description: An ordinary suburban street in Little Whinging where Harry Potter was raised in cruel neglect by his aunt and uncle, the Dursleys, protected there each summer by his mother's ancient blood magic.

name: Hogsmeade
title: The Only All-Wizarding Village
description: A picturesque village near Hogwarts, the only settlement in Britain inhabited entirely by witches and wizards, home to the Three Broomsticks and the Shrieking Shack.

name: King's Cross Station
title: Gateway to Hogwarts
description: A London railway station whose hidden Platform Nine and Three-Quarters lets students board the Hogwarts Express, and whose ethereal afterlife counterpart Harry visited after Voldemort's final curse.

name: Chamber of Secrets
title: Slytherin's Hidden Chamber
description: A secret chamber built beneath Hogwarts by Salazar Slytherin, sealed for a millennium and reopened twice by his heirs to unleash the Basilisk hidden within against Muggle-born students.

name: Riddle House
title: The Riddle Family Manor
description: A decaying mansion in Little Hangleton where Voldemort murdered his Muggle father, Tom Riddle Sr., and his paternal grandparents, and near which he was later reborn in a graveyard ritual using Harry Potter's blood.
